name: io.github.jrpool/kilotest
title: Kilotest
description: Ensemble testing of web pages for accessibility, usability, and web standards

tools.name: getOverview
tools.description: Gets an overview of Kilotest, explaining that it is a front-end quality testing service for the web and describing its tools and the structure of its test results. Call this before any other tool when the tools and workflow are unclear.

tools.name: listSites
tools.description: Lists all tested sites, alphabetically by name, each with its identifier and name and the count of its tested pages. Call this tool first to learn whether a site has been tested. If it has, call listPages to learn which of its pages have been tested. If the site has not been tested and you want it tested, call requestNewTest.

tools.name: listPages
tools.description: Lists the tested pages of one site, each with a page identifier, name, and URL, an array of the sites it belongs to (currently always 1), and the latest report identifier, sorted by page name. Call this after listSites to learn which pages of a site have been tested. Requires a siteID from listSites. After this tool, if you want to know which issues were reported, call listIssues. If you want a different page of the site tested, call requestNewTest.

siteID.description: Identifier of the site, formatted s-xxxxxx (example: s-2fw2ea), as shown in the listSites output

tools.name: listIssues
tools.description: Lists the issues reported in one report, each with an identifier, summary, and priority, sorted by summary. Also lists all the reports about the same page chronologically. Call this tool after listPages to begin getting test results about a page (optionally continuing to drill down with listViolators and listDiagnoses), or to switch to an earlier or later report. Also call this tool after requestNewTest or requestRetest to learn whether the requested test results are available. Requires a reportID from listPages, the list of reports, requestNewTest, or requestRetest. After this tool, if you want to know which elements violated rules belonging to one of the issues, call listViolators. If you want the entire JSON report for analysis outside Kilotest, call getReport instead of this tool, listViolators, or listDiagnoses.

reportID.description: Identifier of the report, formatted YYMMDDTHHMM-xxx (example: 260503T0432-x9z), as shown in the listPages output or a listIssues report history

tools.name: listViolators
tools.description: Lists the elements of one page that were reported as violators of rules belonging to one issue in one report, each with its identifier (catalogIndex), tag name, inner text, and count of reporting rule engines, sorted by identifier. Call this tool after listIssues to continue drilling down. Requires an issueID and a reportID from listIssues. After this tool, if you want to know the diagnoses for a specific violator, call listDiagnoses. If you want the entire JSON report for analysis outside Kilotest, call getReport instead of listIssues, this tool, or listDiagnoses.

issueID.description: Issue identifier (example: contrastPoor), as listed in the listIssues output for the same report

reportID.description: Identifier of the report, formatted YYMMDDTHHMM-xxx (example: 260503T0432-x9z), as shown in the listPages output or a listIssues report history

tools.name: listDiagnoses
tools.description: Lists the diagnoses by rule engines for one violator of rules belonging to one issue in one report, each with a description and severity. Call this after listViolators to continue drilling down. Requires a reportID, issueID, and catalogIndex (element identifier) from listViolators. After this tool, if you want to question a diagnosis, call questionDiagnosis. If you want the entire JSON report for analysis outside Kilotest, call getReport instead of listIssues, listViolators, or this tool.

issueID.description: Issue identifier (example: contrastPoor), as listed in the listIssues output for the same report

reportID.description: Identifier of the report, formatted YYMMDDTHHMM-xxx (example: 260503T0432-x9z), as shown in the listPages output or a listIssues report history

catalogIndex.description: Identifier of the issue-exhibiting element in the catalog of elements on the page (example: 372), as shown in the listViolators output

tools.name: questionDiagnosis
tools.description: Records and submits to management a disagreement with or doubts about one diagnosis reported by the listDiagnoses tool. Call this tool to question a diagnosis or its issue classification. Requires a reportID, issueID, catalogIndex (element identifier), engineID, and ruleID from listDiagnoses, and a reason explaining your concern. If your objection is more general than a single diagnosis, call requestFeature instead.

issueID.description: Issue identifier (example: contrastPoor), as in the listDiagnoses output that showed the disputed diagnosis

reportID.description: Identifier of the report (example: 260503T0432-x9z), as in the listDiagnoses output that showed the disputed diagnosis

catalogIndex.description: Identifier of the issue-exhibiting element in the catalog of elements on the page (example: 372), as in the listDiagnoses output that showed the disputed diagnosis

engineID.description: Identifier of the rule engine that produced the disputed diagnosis (example: axe), as shown in the listDiagnoses output

ruleID.description: Identifier of the rule whose diagnosis is disputed, as shown in the listDiagnoses output (example: color-contrast); if that output shows null for the rule identifier, use its description of the violation instead

reason.description: 20- to 1000-character explanation of why the diagnosis is disputed, evaluated by the reviewing manager

tools.name: getReport
tools.description: Gets an entire report as JSON. Call this tool if you want the full report for analysis outside of Kilotest. Requires a reportID from listPages or listIssues. The listIssues tool discloses the size of a report (typically 0.5 to 2 MB) before you decide whether to download it. If you want only selected results, drill down with listIssues, listViolators, and/or listDiagnoses instead.

reportID.description: Identifier of the report, formatted YYMMDDTHHMM-xxx (example: 260503T0432-x9z), as shown in the listPages output or a listIssues report history

tools.name: requestNewTest
tools.description: Requests that a not yet tested page be tested. Call this tool after listSites or listPages. Requires either a siteID from listSites if the site has been tested, or a siteName, namely the brand or organization name of the site, like the names shown by listSites, but distinct from the name of any tested site when lower-cased and stripped of punctuation and white space. Also requires a pageName describing the purpose of the page, such as home, about, contact, shop, blog, subscribe, sign up, or Benefactors Club; a URL; and a reason justifying the request. If the site has been tested, the pageName must be distinct from the names of all other tested pages of the site shown by listPages. Permits an optional boolean reviewImmediately parameter. If it is true, the response will notify you of approval (with a report identifier, and with an opportunity to call awaitTest and wait for, typically, 2 to 4 minutes), rejection, or queuing for management review. If reviewImmediately is false or omitted, the request will be queued for management review (approval and test completion typically take an hour to a day). If the page has already been tested, call requestRetest instead.

siteID.description: For a page of a site in the listSites output: identifier of the site, formatted s-xxxxxx (example: s-2fw2ea). Give either siteID or siteName, not both.

siteName.description: For a page of a site not in the listSites output: 1- to 80-character name of the site, usually the name of the organization or brand that presents it; it must not match the name of any site in the listSites output, ignoring case, white space, and punctuation. Give either siteID or siteName, not both.

pageName.description: 1- to 120-character name of the page, distinguishing it from every other page of the site (for the home page of a site, “home”)

URL.description: 12- to 300-character URL of the page, including the https:// scheme and any query; it must not redirect to a target this deployment disallows, such as a private, loopback, or link-local address

reason.description: 20- to 100-character justification evaluated by the reviewer selected by reviewImmediately

reviewImmediately.description: true for immediate review with immediate approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved; false or omitted to queue the request for review by management

tools.name: requestRetest
tools.description: Requests that a page be tested again. Call this tool if you have reason to consider the latest report about the page outdated. Requires a reportID from listPages or listIssues and a reason justifying the request. Permits an optional boolean reviewImmediately parameter. If it is true, the response will notify you of approval (with a report identifier, and with an opportunity to call awaitTest and wait for, typically, 2 to 4 minutes), rejection, or queuing for management review. If reviewImmediately is false or omitted, the request will be queued for management review (approval and test completion typically take an hour to a day). If the page has not yet been tested, call requestNewTest instead.

reportID.description: Identifier of the latest report about the page, formatted YYMMDDTHHMM-xxx (example: 260503T0432-x9z); a superseded identifier is rejected

reason.description: 20- to 100-character justification evaluated by the reviewer selected by reviewImmediately

reviewImmediately.description: true for immediate review with immediate approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved; false or omitted to queue the request for review by management

tools.name: requestFeature
tools.description: Requests a new feature or an improvement to an existing one. Requires a feature parameter describing the requested feature or improvement. If you want to question a diagnosis, call questionDiagnosis instead.

feature.description: 20- to 1000-character proposal for a new feature or a feature improvement, evaluated by the reviewing manager

tools.name: awaitTest
tools.description: Blocks and waits for completion (or failure or 5-minute timeout) of a requested job. Call this tool if you requested a new test or retest with immediate review and you want to block the workflow until the test is complete. Requires a reportID from requestNewTest or requestRetest. If you choose not to wait or the wait times out, call listIssues with the reportID later to check whether the results are available.

reportID.description: Report identifier returned by an immediately reviewed test or retest submission for a job pending or in progress (example: 260503T0432-x9z); on completion it remains usable with listIssues and getReport
